source_documents.excerpt: SYNTHETIC. New-member intake. Outside records are partial; allergies, vaccination history, preventive screening history and member priorities still need reconciliation. Member reports gabapentin for an uncertain indication; no disease assessment or verified medication list is available.

candidate.label: Review external chronic kidney disease history

knowledge.title: Kidney history requires longitudinal context
knowledge.text: Chronic kidney disease assessment concerns abnormalities persisting for at least three months. One low eGFR during an acute illness cannot establish chronicity; retrieve longitudinal measurements and the clinician assessment.

final_finding.label: Review external chronic kidney disease history
final_finding.reasoning: The supplied record contains no adequate documentation of this history. Request additional records rather than infer a condition.
